note: Both sets repeat the same core facts (50° solar altitude at fall equinox 12pm, 0° window azimuth, 1:1 depth-to-height spacing, 25° structural bend, truncated isosceles triangle profile), but Set B garbles the governing formula four times by dropping tan(solar elevation)/Cos(solar azimuth – window azimuth) and also asserts a 'depth-to-height ratio 1.2' that contradicts the stated 1:1 ratio, plus an invented 'average' condition on the bend. Set A keeps the full formula in at least one claim, adds the powder-coated finish and correct shape/finish bindings, and its main defects are truncated or paraphrased quotes (e.g. 'louver hern azimuth', '50 sing the fall equinox') and two mis-stated formula claims. Set A therefore has fewer substantive misreadings and better coverage, though both sets are heavily duplicated and contain misbound 'spacing formula' claims.
